image_prompts.purpose: Week 3 opener board for fast garment recognition and bridge into the new vocabulary set.
image_prompts.visual_description: An adult-oriented educational garment board showing several common Week 3 items such as a dress, jeans, hoodie, jacket, blouse, and blazer, each clearly visible as a separate garment visual.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished educational fashion-illustration style with realistic garment shapes and clean edges.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the garments evenly spaced on a neutral background so each silhouette is easy to identify at small size.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid runway scenes, brand logos, childlike styling, folded clothes, or garments hidden by poses.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for tops and upper garments in the core matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clean fashion-education vocabulary board showing T-shirt, shirt, blouse, sweater, hoodie, and cardigan as separate adult garment visuals.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a realistic but simple illustration style suited to language learning.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make the collar, button, sleeve, and hood differences visually clear without adding labels inside the image.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid mannequins with dramatic poses, decorative backgrounds, and garments overlapping each other.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for bottoms and one-piece garments in the core matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: A clear board showing skirt, pants, shorts, jeans, dress, and jumpsuit as separate beginner-friendly garment visuals.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational illustration style with strong silhouette contrast.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep dress and skirt clearly different, and make pants and jeans recognizable as related but distinct items.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid busy fabric prints, folded garments, or tiny details that hide the overall shape.

image_prompts.purpose: Vocabulary board for outerwear and complete-look words in the core matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: A board showing jacket, coat, blazer, and one simple outfit or look as separate adult-oriented fashion-study visuals.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished educational fashion style with clear garment structure.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Make the blazer look more structured and formal than the jacket. Keep the outfit visual simple enough to read as a full look.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid catwalk backgrounds, text labels, and highly stylized poses that distract from the garments.

image_prompts.purpose: Single reading-support image board for matching three short garment descriptions to the correct visual.
image_prompts.visual_description: One board with three clearly separated garments, such as a white shirt with buttons, a blue dress, and black jeans, each easy to compare visually.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational illustration style with realistic adult garment proportions.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the three garments equally prominent and visually distinct so students can answer reading-detail questions from one image.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra accessories, patterned backgrounds, and partial garment crops.

image_prompts.purpose: Reusable garment card or gallery set for listening support, Garment ID Card selection, and teacher-led speaking.
image_prompts.visual_description: A reusable card set or gallery layout showing jacket, skirt, shorts, blouse, dress, jeans, and coat as separate garment choices for beginner learners.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clear, adult-oriented flashcard or gallery style that works both on screen and in print.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Give each garment enough space to stand alone and keep the background minimal for quick recognition in class.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid decorative typography, accessories that hide the garment shape, and clothing combinations that make single-item identification difficult.
